author: Mark Atwood
text: SCOPE NOTE 2026-05-12 (cascade from PKIX-jy95.6 = A): batch interface shape is now a property of the BRIDGE crate (pkix-zlint-bridge per PKIX-jy95.7). Both pkix-policy-zlint adapter AND pkix-difftest oracle consume the bridge's batch API; both will benefit equally from a good batch shape. The bridge subprocess economics (one process per session, many certs fed through stdin/file/array) belongs in the bridge crate. Adapter layer just chooses single-cert or batch as appropriate for the calling context.
